name: JellyNext
description: A Jellyfin plugin that creates per-user virtual libraries for personalized Trakt recommendations and new seasons. Seamlessly integrates with Radarr and Sonarr to trigger one-click downloads directly from Jellyfin.
overview: Trakt recommendations sync with Sonarr/Radarr support.

versions.changelog:
### Features

- **Watchlist fallback for failed downloads**: When playing a virtual item and the download request fails (for example Radarr/Sonarr is offline), the item is added to the player's Trakt watchlist instead
  - New per-user setting `AddToWatchlistOnDownloadFailure` (enabled by default) in the Trakt user settings tab
  - With watchlist sync enabled, the item is downloaded automatically once the download system is reachable again
  - Applies to all download modes (Native, Jellyseerr, Webhook); shows are added to the watchlist as a whole show

### Bug Fixes

- **Plugin not listed in the Jellyfin 12 catalogue**: Changed the plugin GUID to `5dd43faa-22d2-4cf5-90fc-f00bc30fd807`
  - The previous GUID collides with the official OpenLibrary plugin introduced in Jellyfin 12, so Jellyfin merged JellyNext into OpenLibrary's catalogue entry
  - Existing settings are kept (the configuration file is named after the assembly, not the GUID)
  - If an older JellyNext version is installed, uninstall it before installing this one
